en: You can confess to me whenever you want. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'll think about it.

Sounds like you need to work on it.
Want to practice on me?

What? Where did you get that idea?
But, that might be fun...
Okay. Here goes nothin'.
Kiryu-san... I've always...

You just looked so serious, Kiryu-san!
It was funny for some reason.

...Confessing is hard, huh?
Thanks for lettin' me practice on you.

Let me know if you ever want
to give it another shot.

Huh what huh?
Have you ever heard of tact?

Why do you even care?
Kiryu-san, you're like a pervy old man.

I'm still not really thinking about marriage...
Maybe I should be?

Well, focusing on your job is admirable. You
wouldn't be able to give it your all, otherwise.

You get me, Kiryu-san.
Yeah. I want to focus on my career for now.
Is that a compliment?

Of course.
I think your whole presentation is great.

Kiryu-san... I'm thrilled! I actually put a lot
of effort into my presentation.

Does that mean I'm doing a good job?
That was just the boost of confidence I needed.

I feel like I might have
seen you in Osaka, too.
Were you in Osaka a long time ago?
Yeah, I end up there pretty frequently.

Then maybe we really have
seen each other before.

Thanks! I'm not too confident about it,
though. It's nice to hear that, though.

I'd never forgive someone who cheated on me.
You'd better never, Kiryu-san!
O-Of course not.

Outdoor dates are great! If we went out,
I'd want to see some beautiful scenery.

Relaxing at home is nice now and then. But if
that's all ya ever do... it's just a bit sad.

Is that how I look?
I didn't!

Is that a marriage proposal?
I'd have preferred a more romantic line...
Sorry, I'm no good at miso soup...

Saying stuff like that only makes you
sound older and older, you know.

I haven't gone lately, actually.
I used to go a lot, though.
Do you go a lot, Kiryu-san?
Well, now and then.
Huh. What kind of songs do you sing?

I used to sing a lot of Enka.
Stuff like "Kamuro Lullaby."

Wow, that's so refined.
It really makes you seem like a mature man.

Rock!
Stuff like "Machine Gun Kiss."

Rock, huh? You have a great voice,
so I bet you sound cool!
I-Interjections?

Yeah. I'm better at getting the mood going
than singing myself.

Really...?
Kiryu-san, you're an odd one.

Really? 
Personally I prefer guys that are more safe.

Wow, I've never met anyone like him.
He sounds very... unique?

A friend in the police, huh?
Kiryu-san, were you a bad boy?
Well... somewhat.

You're friends with a hot-shot like that?
I'd like to pick his brain.

He's from Kansai too, huh?
Maybe we could be friends. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Wow, he's the chairman of the organization?
That's amazing for his age.

There's a sophisticated feel to that place, right?
Seems like a good place to relax.
Kiryu-san! Sorry I'm late. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Did you have to wait long...?
Kiryu-san! I couldn't wait to see you again! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Karaoke! Nice choice!

That sounds fun!
I never really get to play darts.
C'mon, let's go. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I wonder what song you'll sing... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Let's see...
What should I sing today? <symbol=note_with_outline>
I'm not so hot at darts, so go easy on me!
All right! Let's do this!

W-Well, we're just getting started.
We can still have some fun, right...?

That was fun! <symbol=note_with_outline>
We should do this again sometime.

That was so fun! <symbol=heart_with_outline> It's rare to have a
customer who's so fun to hang out with!

Well, it's about that time.
Let's head back to the club.

Oh, I love this song! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I want you to hear it. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Cool, they have this song at karaoke? <symbol=note_with_outline>
That's the one I'm singing then.

Hm... I'm having a hard time getting
in the groove today...
Kiryu-san! That's kinda distracting...

That was so fun!
You're great at getting the mood going. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I feel like I sang my heart out. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
You made me feel right at home. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hey, you're gonna sing something too, right? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Aww... I wanted to hear what you sound like...

Um, well...
I think I could tell what you were going for!

You're a great singer! <symbol=note_with_outline>
You had me swept up in your voice.

How did you become such a good singer!?
I just want to listen to you forever... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Huh? Really!?
You've got deep pockets. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh, that one's really good. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I like it, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Nice to meet you.
I'm Saki.
Fun fact, I'm actually a pro wrestler.

Huh. That's unusual.
This should be fun.

I'm glad to hear you say that.
Um, can I ask what your name is?
Yeah. Kazuma Kiryu.

Kiryu-san, then!
Let's have some fun today then, hm? <symbol=note_with_outline>

Thanks for requesting me today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Think you'll come back again...?
Yeah, I had a good time.
I'm happy to hear that.
Kiryu-san, I'm glad you came back.
Kiryu-san, I've been waiting for you. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Kiryu-san, I've been hoping you'd
show up... <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I'm glad we got to spend more time together
than usual today. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Come on in.

Thanks for coming today.
Hope to see you again.

Thanks for coming today. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You'd better come back, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Thank you, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I want to see you again soon... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'll see you later, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Do you have a sec?

Here's my number.
I expect you to invite me out sometime, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

It's almost time.
What do you wanna do?

Time's up...
That really flew by.
Yay! I knew I could count on you, Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Thanks a lot for today.
Yeah, I totally know what you mean!
No doubt about it.

I agree!
I feel the same way.
Huh? I don't think so.
Hmm... Really?
Sorry, I don't really get it.

I have to say, it's rare for someone
to be both a hostess and a pro wrestler.
Yeah, that's what everyone says.
How do you feel about that?

Guys request me for the novelty of it, but the
reaction's not great if they wanted a "traditional" girl.

Kinda makes me wonder... should I try to act
more feminine so I can be more popular?
You are who you are, right?

You shouldn't have to hide who you really are.
Your physique sets you apart, as far as I'm concerned.

Kiryu-san... Y-You're right!
I was getting kinda self-conscious.
You sound more optimistic already.

Yeah! I'll aim for the number one
spot in my own way!
Yeah, and I'll support you however I can.
Well, you are kind of manly.

You're right... but guys do say it
makes me easier to talk to, though.

Then, why not use that to your advantage?
You just have to own it and stay optimistic.

You're right. No point being indecisive!
I'll try to be more optimistic!

There you go.
That's a manly thing to say.

Come on, Kiryu-san.
Don't tease me.
I love... wrestling.

What!? Pro wrestling?
Aren't you supposed to say you love me?

Just kidding. But I do think talking so
casually like this is part of your charm.

Kiryu-san... That's true.
I do have my own way of doing things.

I'm feeling more optimistic now!
Thank you, Kiryu-san.
No problem. Good luck.

By the way, Saki, why'd you go into pro
wrestling? What was your motivation?

Actually I wasn't interested at all at first,
but the more I did it, the more I fell in love.

Before I realized it, going pro had its hooks
in me. I've been working hard at it ever since!

There were some bumps in the road, but I managed
to make connections and now I'm a pro wrestler.
Huh. So you didn't like it at the start.

Right. But I saw this match that really moved me.
It's like that match gave me a purpose in life.

When I saw that, I decided I wanted to be able
to move people in the same way.

That's great.
I'd like to see if you stir my emotions, too.

Kiryu-san, you've got it. I'll work at it
until I've met your expectations!

Someday maybe I'll let you
touch my championship belt.
I'd like to move you, too.

Huh? Are you going to take up pro wrestling, too?
You do look capable enough...

No, you just looked so happy talking about your
dreams. It made me feel like I have to keep up.

In that sense...
maybe you've already moved me.

Kiryu-san... That makes me so happy.
I hope I can really stir your emotions someday!
Do one of your moves on me!
Huh? Where'd that come from, Kiryu-san?

Well, I just thought I'd get a taste of what you
felt if you did one of your moves on me.

All you'd get from that is sore.
If you wanna be moved, come see a match sometime.

Okay.
Looking forward to it.

So now I know why you became a pro wrestler,
but what made you decide to become a hostess?

I'm a tomboy and I'm a pro wrestler on top of it,
so I wanted to become more feminine.

I thought being a hostess might help me polish
that aspect of myself. Also... well, the money.
Money?

Yeah. The team I'm on isn't very big,
so we're pretty poor, if I'm being honest.

Even when I fight, the money isn't very good.
A lot of us have part-time jobs on the side.

And when you get hurt you have to pay for the
treatment... the costs really add up.

I see... Sounds like being a pro wrestler
can be kind of rough.

It is. Someday I'd like to be able
to focus on just wrestling, though.

It's great that you want to focus on wrestling,
but... that wouldn't be great for me.
Huh? Why's that?

Because I wouldn't be able
to see you anymore, of course.

Kiryu-san...
Gosh, what are you saying?

But, you're right. I've actually met a lot of
people here that I've turned into wrestling fans.

I should continue working here and aim for the
top for their sake!

Nice. Wouldn't it be even better to aim
for the top in both jobs?

Totally. I'll aim for the champion's
belt in the cabaret trade, too!
What if I supported you?

Really? That's so nice of you.
But, I'm happy enough that you offered.

I want to at least be able
to support my own lifestyle.

I don't feel like I could entertain an audience
if I were living off someone else's money.

I like that determination.
You're a real professional, Saki.

But, when I retire from wrestling and run
out of money, maybe I'll come knocking, huh?
Then you should just marry me.
Huh!? Kiryu-san, where'd that come from!?

Well, if we got married,
I could support you as family.

Oh, I see.
I didn't think of it that way...

But sheesh... That caught me off guard.
My heart's still racing...

It was just a what-if.
Sorry to make you panic.

No, this'll make a great fantasy...
Thanks for the idea!
Ooh, that's pretty good, too...

What happened?
You're grinning ear to ear.

Oh, sorry!
I was off in fantasy land.

Ohhh. Hm?
Is that your fantasy notebook there?

Yeah, it is. I write down my fantasy scenarios
so I can come back to them later.

So diligent.
Why would you need to, though?

So I can reuse them. That way I can enjoy
the same fantasy as many times as I want.

Wow... There's all sorts of stuff in here.
Hmm? "Kiryu-san Scenarios"...?

Waaahhhhh! You can't look at that one!
Geez, don't even open that, please!
O-Oh. Sorry.

I can't let my guard down for
a second around you. Too close!

Being around you makes me think
fantasizing might be kind of fun.

It is fun! I recommend it.
What do you say we give it a try!?

So, Kiryu-san, what kind of scenario
would you imagine me in?
A pro wrestler, I guess?

That's what I already am.
Put some imagination into it, please!
Hm... This is pretty hard.

Sometimes I do find myself in
fantasies based on reality, though.

Like, you invite me out on a date after work,
and then you surprise me with a bouquet...

Hey, I thought I was supposed
to be the one fantasizing.
My wife, I guess.

Wha!? Um...
You mean we'd be... married?

Yeah. It's fun talking with you,
so it's not hard to imagine us married.

Kiryu-san... Oh man, this is kind of
embarrassing. But, I'm really happy...

You know, you don't have to let it end as a
fantasy... We could make it a reality... Maybe?
Hm? What was that?

No-no-no-nope-nope-nope!
This is turning out to be a good day! <symbol=heart_with_outline>
My mom, I guess.
What!? You mean I would be your mom?

Yeah. I feel like you'd do
a great job raising me.
